_meta.title: Cruising A+B retained listing research QA positions 76–80
_meta.method: Original dated community posts and site-reference mapping contrasted with official operator/current access references. Archived eight-source matching not a full current authenticated scan. No claims of verified sexual activity or permission in public places.

records.name: Kulkwitzer See Westufer
records.geography: West bank of Kulkwitzer See by Salzstraße on Markranstädt side. Saved 51.306284,12.238877 general west shore, distinct from named east/other lake shore spots. Source doesn't identify particular secluded subsection.

activity.detail: Poster says some activity still happens in good weather, no explicit witnessed encounter or exact time.

records.access: Public lake recreation subject to municipal summer bathing, habitat and posted shore rules; no current private beach boundaries independently checked.
records.duplicates: Separate west versus east named lake shores; do not conflate broad lake reporting.
issues: No confirmed 2026 encounter or dependable busyness.
General shore is geolocated sufficiently; specific claimed spot not.
Official lake association governance changes do not establish closures of western beach.

Exact named motorway parking area and whether original point is south/east/west carriageway not independently established. Separate from other named A6 highway rest stops.

Visitor says daytime quiet, asks when active.

records.access: Motorway facilities must be approached in correct legal direction, rest-stop vegetation may be restricted, no arbitrary GPS assignment to opposite side.
records.duplicates: Do not merge with another A6 stop merely because highway/city labels overlap.
issues: Improve existing location wording to state source-supplied OSM point exists, but stop name/access side remains unverified.
No confirmed busy hours; negative and neutral visitor reports coexist.
Source exact side and current parking available remains uncertain.

records.name: A94 Ende in Marktl - unter der Alzbrücke
records.geography: Original Gays-Cruising source driving link embeds 48.247253418,12.8153371811 at A94 bridge over Alz near Marktl. Source says parking on both sides; one map destination is not legal access route for both. Named bridge not Marktl village square.
records.access: Bridge embankment and river/highway service access can be private/traffic restricted; do not infer public access under bridge or use motorway crossing.
records.duplicates: Potential multiple entry sides on the same bridge, not automatically different venues or one unified road arrival.
issues: Source original map pin genuinely recovered: keep it as site-reference, not both-side navigation.
Check road/footway regulation before any directions.

records.name: Parkplatz an der B 471
records.geography: Source directions B471 from Garching towards Ismaning immediately after Isar/Heckerbrücke. Independent public hiking map references 48.238688,11.673832 on Ismaning side. Original text also acknowledges parking on both directions; do not present sole coordinate as all parking. Planet Randy 'Isar-Kiesbank' may concern same riverside but not proven; keep duplicate risk noted.

activity.detail: Forum contributor describes observing people enter woods and says one can find men in dry weather; no dated explicit sexual encounter.
Visitor says went on Thursday and Saturday and saw nobody. Preserve both.

records.access: Public riverside trails and car park around protected Isar area, no assumption of unrestricted woodland/riverbank access. Source highway crossings/parking bays can differ.
records.duplicates: Potential same-place 'Isar-Kiesbank' in Planet Randy not verified as equal; avoid merge without coordinates/description match.
issues: Old listed City 'Munich' is region, physical location in Ismaning/Garching border; flag for future corrected municipality.
June 2026 opposing reports require preserving rather than one-sided busy time claims.
Historical 2011 crime article is not current access or safety evidence.

records.name: Olympiabad
records.geography: Munich Olympia-Schwimmhalle, Coubertinplatz 1, 80809 München, official operator SWM; stored building coords 48.17357,11.55148 plausible. No source-specific present shower/cubicle identified.
records.access: Current SWM official bath Mon–Sun 07:00–23:00, sauna Mon 10:00–23:00 and Tue–Sun 08:00–23:00, ladies sauna Tuesday 08:00–23:00. Standard pool €6.90 and sauna €23 for four hours. Specific event restrictions Nov5 full early closure, Nov6–7 certain pools limited (these dates now past), forthcoming Nov15 water sports festival prevents regular swim until evening 19:30, and Nov16–17 sauna all day closed for safety work. These are public use notices, not cruising data.
records.duplicates: A municipal athletics pool is NOT gay men's sauna; no other same place duplicate established.
issues: MATERIAL practical info: dates Nov15–17 upcoming operator event/sauna service restrictions.
Do not label any shower, sauna or pool as gay cruising approved space; current source 2026 simply asks whether activity occurs.
If future approved listing includes opening times, distinguish public swim and sauna plus ladies' day.
